messages:
lena_sales: Quick sync — Rod at HelixMed wants SOC2 summary + pen-test attestation naming HelixMed, plus a 2-week EU private UAT. They need evidence by 2025-02-10. Can we confirm what we'll share and cost?

omar_se: For UAT we can offer temporary VPN (mTLS) or VPC peering. Ephemeral creds are fine for dev testing. We'll supply a small staging network diagram.

marta_compliance: Shareable: redacted SOC2 Type II executive summary, ISO scope doc, and a pen-test attestation letter (high-level only). Do not share raw reports without NDA. Evidence transfer requires client-signed evidence-handling attestation.

client_rod: Procurement: "Please include legal signatory name on the attestation and a line-item quote for EU node + VPN setup." Also prefer presigned S3 with 7-day expiry for transfer.

legal_lead: Signatory: Priya Kaur, Head of Legal — can sign within 48 hours after draft approval. If full report requested, NDA required.

lena_sales: Billing quick estimate: EU 2-week node (pro-rated) = $2,400 one-time. VPN/mTLS setup = $1,000 one-time. Presigned S3 transfer recommended.

omar_se: Ephemeral key example for UAT:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer UAT_KEY" https://eu.api.redwood.inference/v1/ping
```
Keys expire after 14 days.

marta_compliance: Redaction checklist: remove customer PII, internal IPs, and exploit PoCs. CVE IDs OK if public. We'll prepare the draft by 2025-02-05.
lena_sales: Action items: 1) Marta draft pack + attestation by 2025-02-05. 2) Legal sign within 48h of draft. 3) Omar generate presigned S3 link when ready. 4) I'll send formal amendment with line items after billing confirms.

client_rod: Sounds good — we'll review and avoid asking for full report to keep timeline tight. Thanks team.
